[Athamaru Lore](/Feats.aspx?ID=5273) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Athamaru" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=741" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 18

</column>

---

You've immersed yourself in community learning, particularly around navigating the waters and tending to animals. You gain the trained proficiency rank in [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) and [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=43). If you automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

 You also gain the [Additional Lore](/Feats.aspx?ID=5114) general feat for Athamaru [Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8).
name: Athamaru Lore
